title: ophrys scolopax subsp. isaura
intro: Ophrys scolopax subsp. isaura, commonly known as the Isaurian Bee Orchid, is a rare and endemic subspecies of orchid found in the mountainous regions of Turkey. This plant is used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues due to its reported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Ophrys scolopax subsp. isaura include soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and supporting immune function. The bioactive constituents of the plant are attributed to its flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
